name: A model whose base is a parametrized abstract-collection alias structures
expected_behavior: Structuring a model that declares a parametrized abstract-collection interface as a base class succeeds and yields the same value the unparametrized base would, instead of raising AttributeError about a missing '__parameters__'.

name: A converter carries the "key on field aliases" decision itself
expected_behavior: Converter(use_alias=True) makes both structuring and unstructuring key on field aliases for every model it handles; copy() inherits the setting and copy(use_alias=False) turns it off; a default converter still keys on field names.

name: Unstructuring a parametrized generic works under deferred annotations
expected_behavior: Unstructuring against a parametrized generic target in a module with deferred annotations produces the primitive payload instead of raising TypeError from the annotation resolution step; non-generic models are unaffected.

name: An abstract sequence annotation structures into a hashable tuple
expected_behavior: Structuring against an abstract sequence annotation yields an immutable, hashable tuple on both shipped converters and inside model fields, while mutable-sequence and list annotations still yield mutable lists.

name: The "no handler registered" error survives a pickle round trip
expected_behavior: StructureHandlerNotFoundError exposes every value it was constructed from, can be pickled and unpickled with its type attribute intact, stays raisable and catchable afterwards, and still prints only its message.

name: The "extra keys" error renders deterministically and survives pickling
expected_behavior: ForbiddenExtraKeysError lists the offending keys in sorted order in its generated message, exposes every value it was constructed from so it survives a pickle round trip with its class and key set intact, and still prints an explicitly supplied message verbatim.

name: A pass-through union that accepts floats also accepts whole numbers
expected_behavior: When the pass-through strategy is configured with both int and float, an int passes a union listing only float and is returned unchanged as an int, including inside model fields; a float is still rejected by an int-only union and declared members pass through untouched.

name: A distinct type alias over a model unstructures the value behind it
expected_behavior: On BaseConverter, unstructuring against a NewType declared over a modelled class produces the same primitive payload as unstructuring against that class, including stacked aliases and alias-annotated fields.

name: A subclass registry rooted at a generic parent can be tagged
expected_behavior: include_subclasses on a parametrized generic parent combined with the tagged-union strategy registers without raising and round-trips each subclass through its discriminator; non-generic parents keep working.

name: Omit-if-default compares against the converted default
expected_behavior: With omit_if_default on, a freshly constructed model whose fields declare converters (plain callable, factory default, converter object, converter object reading the instance) unstructures to an empty payload; values differing from the converted default are still emitted and fields without converters are unchanged.

name: An enum that declares its member value type round-trips
expected_behavior: An enum annotating `_value_` unstructures by converting its member value through the declared type and structures by converting the payload through it before member lookup, on both shipped converters; enums without the annotation are unchanged.

name: Per-field settings on a field annotation are honoured for classes
expected_behavior: `Annotated[T, override(...)]` on an attrs class or dataclass field is picked up by any converter for renaming, omission and per-field hooks in both directions, with no registration step; explicitly registered settings still win and unannotated fields keep their names.

name: Structuring into a parametrized generic works under deferred annotations
expected_behavior: Structuring a payload into a parametrized generic in a module with deferred annotations succeeds for builtin and modelled parameters, for multi-parameter generics, and for a generic nested inside a generic; non-generic models are unaffected.

name: An abstract set annotation structures into a hashable frozenset
expected_behavior: Structuring against an abstract set annotation yields an immutable, hashable frozenset on both shipped converters and inside model fields, while mutable-set and built-in set annotations still yield mutable sets.

name: A hierarchy with a multiply-reachable class can be tagged
expected_behavior: include_subclasses combined with the tagged-union strategy registers a hierarchy in which a class is reachable from the root by several paths, listing that class once, and round-trips every member through its discriminator; single-path hierarchies keep working.

name: Per-field settings on a field annotation are honoured for mapping shapes
expected_behavior: `Annotated[T, override(...)]` on a TypedDict field or on a dict-shaped NamedTuple field is picked up by any converter for renaming and omission in both directions; unannotated fields keep their names.
